brands.name: Somma Special Designs
brands.short_description: Hand-shaped custom surfboards by Shea Somma in San Luis Obispo, California since 2008.

models.name: Ham & Cheese
models.description: The Ham and Cheese is a log designed around traditional longboarding at California reefs, points, and softer beachbreaks. A parallel template with a blunt nose and wide tail create a moving sidewalk feel, with panel vee, rocker lift, and a scooped deck in the aft end for lofty, controlled noserides.

models.name: Judah
models.description: The Judah is a trim-oriented midlength egg designed around Ocean Beach's shifting moods. It cruises in the small stuff and charges when the waves come up. The pulled-in tail and concave to spiral vee bottom give control through steep sections and let you lay down carves when the opportunity presents itself.

models.name: Cochon
models.description: The Cochon is a modern pig-styled longboard with reverse rocker, rolled bottom contours, wide point aft, soft rails, and a subtle blended nose concave. It can be ripped harder than the average classic log and still noseride beautifully in the pocket. The curvy template and narrow nose suit beach-break logging.

models.name: Daydream Hull
models.description: A beachbreak-oriented displacement hull cooked up for Kyle Kennelley at Daydream Surf Shop in Costa Mesa. It translates the effortless trim, full rail engagement, and ball-bearing feel of a hull into a smaller, shorter package for the quick adjustments beachbreaks require.

models.name: Mini Super
models.description: A Mini Simmons-style shred stick: short, wide, fast, and skatey. A hull entry into a deep, channeled concave running through the twin keel fins makes mincemeat of mushy surf and still goes extremely fast on groomed days.

models.name: La Chancla
models.description: A sidecut fish inspired by Ryan Burch's twin-fin designs. The break in the template sits between the rider's feet, creating a pivot point ahead of the fins for a tighter arcing turn than a traditional fish. Extra tail rocker and a single concave make it sensitive and responsive.

models.name: Wadlog
models.description: A round-pintail, single-fin, wide-point-centered log for kneeslappers up to overhead. The most user-friendly, all-around log in the lineup, with smooth rail-to-rail transitions, easy noseriding, and a trim-oriented approach. Recommended for beginners or anyone who wants a forgiving go-to longboard.

models.name: Classic Fish
models.description: A compact twin-fin fish with a short, wide template, deep swallowtail, keel fins, and down-rails. Shea shapes a channeled concave through the tail to add modern performance to this classic design. It works from knee-high and soft to overhead and barreling.

models.name: Duckface
models.description: The most high-performance board in the line — the shortboard of the group. A blunt-nosed template with a continuous curve, simple single concave, and extra tail rocker. The blunted nose adds paddle volume and stability. Built as a thruster or quad.

models.name: MLP
models.description: A short, wide, performance-oriented board inspired by the Channel Islands Biscuit and Gary Hanel's Diet Pill. Plenty of foam nose to tail for paddling, with shortboard-style rails, low rocker, a round tail, and a light single-to-double concave. Standard 5-box setup for thruster or quad.

models.name: Channeled Twin Pin
models.description: An alternative step-up that marries the loose, free feeling of twin fins with the drive and hold of a pintail. Wide-point-forward template with channels for bite, control, and thrust in larger surf, plus thicker foil for paddle power. Intended for when the waves are pumping.
